The practice

Sheet 02 / About the studio

We start every project with the same question — how does someone move through this room on an ordinary Tuesday? — before we touch a floor plan.

Studio philosophy

Good design disappears into daily life. We measure a project's success less by how it photographs and more by how quietly it works six months after move-in.

180+
Sqm avg. project
96%
Client referral rate
6 wk
Avg. design phase

Almeric Studio is a small architecture and interior design practice working on residential renovations, new-build homes, and considered commercial interiors. We keep project teams small on purpose — the people who sketch your concept are the same people on site for the final punch-list.

Every project is drawn to fit its site, its light, and its budget, not fitted to a template. That's slower work, and we think it shows.
